mechanism: Amoxicillin clavulanate may reduce propafenone efficacy by altering gut flora and enterohepatic circulation, while propafenone metabolism via CYP3A4/2D6 may be affected by concurrent medication use.
action: Monitor cardiac rhythm and propafenone efficacy during antibiotic therapy; consider ECG monitoring if signs of arrhythmia recurrence appear; counsel on consistent timing of doses.
